messages.text: The grain cart arrived at River Depot.
The timber wagon reached River Depot.
Both unloading crews share the north ramp.

main_story.headline: River Depot Logistics Facilitate Consistent Resource Throughput
main_story.lede: Daily operations at the River Depot saw steady resource arrivals as coordination between crews kept the transit infrastructure functioning without delay.
main_story.body: The River Depot functioned as the primary hub for regional logistics on June 1. Asha confirmed the arrival of a grain cart, followed promptly by Ben, who noted the unloading of 20 grain sacks. Simultaneously, Cato reported the arrival of a timber wagon, which Asha specified contained 14 pine beams. Despite the influx of materials, workflow remained efficient as the teams successfully managed the shared transit point. Ben observed that both unloading crews utilize the north ramp, a detail confirmed by Cato, who noted that the ramp remains clear. This operational cooperation ensured that all grain and timber shipments were processed without creating a bottleneck at the facility.

image.caption: View of the north ramp at River Depot during operations.
